Your Porto weekend note now has a page. You'll find it under Page in the note. I haven't opened it on your phone, so I haven't tried the button.

- **Reminder button:** "Set reminder" creates a phone reminder, "Pack for Porto (flight tomorrow 07:10)", for Thursday 15 Oct at 20:00. It works out the date from the "out fri 16 oct 07:10" line in the note. Your phone will ask permission the first time. I picked 20:00 myself, so tell me if you want a different time.
- **The rest of the page:**
  - a countdown to the flight
  - the flight, hotel and budget details
  - your ideas list
  - the to-do checklist, which you can tick on the page and it updates the note

The note's text is unchanged.

Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
